stories.title: Israel bombs petrol station in southern Lebanon
stories.summary: An Israeli airstrike struck a petrol station in southern Lebanon near the Rashidieh Camp for Palestinian refugees.

stories.title: US markets surge after Trump announces he’s postponing strikes on Iran
stories.summary: Major US financial markets opened higher following President Donald Trump's announcement that he was postponing planned strikes on Iran.

stories.title: Large pro-government rallies held in Tehran
stories.summary: Large pro-government demonstrations took place in Tehran, with crowds waving Iranian flags and chanting in support of the government.

stories.title: Colombian military plane crash kills at least 66
stories.summary: A Colombian military plane crash killed at least 66 people, with the defence minister calling it a tragic accident while the cause remains unclear.

stories.title: Inside the alleged Russian operation to trigger anti-government protests in Angola
stories.summary: A group of Russians and Angolans are standing trial in Angola on accusations of attempting to foment anti-government protests, charges which the defendants deny.

stories.title: UK universities flock to India - but will they succeed?
stories.summary: Nine UK universities are establishing campuses in India, though initial student enrolment is expected to be modest.

stories.title: Oil falls and shares rebound after Trump says talks have been held to end war
stories.summary: Oil prices fell and global stock markets rebounded after US President Donald Trump announced that talks had been held to end the war, describing them as very good and productive.

stories.title: A committed pharmacist and a homesick blogger – the Iranian civilians killed in the war
stories.summary: Civilian casualties continue to rise in Iran as the US-Israeli military campaign continues, with victims including a pharmacist and a blogger.

stories.title: Ex-teacher accused of Scotland school abuse found guilty of sex attack in South Africa
stories.summary: A court in Cape Town, South Africa, found former Scottish teacher Iain Wares guilty of indecently assaulting a former student who accused him of sexual abuse dating back to the 1980s.

stories.title: US' and Iran's options for ending war narrow the longer it goes on
stories.summary: The ongoing conflict between the US and Iran shows limited options for resolution, with Iran refusing to back down and US air power alone unable to achieve its primary objectives.

stories.title: Blast that injured two was 'terrorist attack', Ukrainian authorities say
stories.summary: Ukrainian authorities have declared a blast that injured two people a terrorist attack, with a 21-year-old local suspect claiming he was blackmailed into planting the explosives.

stories.title: Australia's ABC staff to go on strike for first time in 20 years
stories.summary: Staff at Australia's ABC public broadcaster plan to strike for 24 hours, marking the first such action in 20 years and expected to disrupt live television and radio programming.

stories.title: France's Socialists hold on to power in major cities in election boost for mainstream
stories.summary: France's Socialist Party retained control of Paris and Marseille in local elections, while the nationalist right won in Nice and several other towns.

stories.title: Israeli settlers target Palestinian villages in occupied West Bank, attacking people and properties
stories.summary: Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian villages and properties in the occupied West Bank following the death of 18-year-old settler Yehuda Sherman, who was reportedly struck by a Palestinian-driven vehicle.

stories.title: National blackout hits Cuba for second time in a week
stories.summary: Cuba experienced its second nationwide power grid failure in a week amid ongoing hardship linked to fuel shortages.

stories.title: Israel to expand ground and air attacks against Hezbollah in Lebanon
stories.summary: Israel has announced plans to expand its ground and air military operations against Hezbollah in Lebanon, raising concerns among Lebanese civilians about a potential large-scale ground invasion.

stories.title: Iranian missiles injure 180 in towns near Israeli nuclear site
stories.summary: Iranian ballistic missiles struck areas near an Israeli nuclear facility, injuring approximately 180 people. Israeli authorities are investigating how the missiles penetrated the country's advanced air defense systems.

stories.title: Car stolen with two-month-old baby inside
stories.summary: A car was stolen with a two-month-old baby boy inside. Police located and rescued the infant unharmed, reuniting him with his mother shortly after the incident.

stories.title: Venezuelan leader replaces senior military commanders
stories.summary: Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro has replaced senior military commanders following the appointment of a new defence minister by Vice President Delcy Rodríguez. Human rights organizations have criticized the reshuffle as a continuation of institutional impunity.
